Resolves #21695

Examples group links use the existing neutral surface hover token in Neo Dark and Neo Light. The previous background token matched the inherited text in both themes, so hovering could erase the label.

Evidence: L3 (actual Portal route in Chromium, both themes) → L3 required (rendered contrast, pointer hover and keyboard focus). Residual: none.

Related: #21140

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` samples the painted Trees row and requires 4.5:1 contrast for the label and count in both skins. |
| AC-2 | The same test checks the selected marker during pointer hover and tabs onto Trees to observe its focus outline. |
| AC-3 | Both new cases failed at 1.0:1 on `6952886dce` with the test-only change. The full spec passed with both token changes. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The new check reuses the catalog spec’s PNG decoder and sRGB luminance calculation.

## Test Evidence

The complete `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` run passed 30/30 in Chromium with an isolated Neural Link bridge. I also checked the `/apps/portal/#/examples` overview at 1440 × 900 in both themes. The Trees row keeps a visible hover fill, foreground and count. The selected All examples row keeps its marker, and Tab onto Trees shows the focus outline.

Frame critique: The dark theme painted a light hover over light text, and the light theme showed the corresponding dark-on-dark defect. Both fixed frames keep the label and count readable.

| Theme | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Neo Dark | ![Neo Dark, before, with Trees hovered](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/736e061f16097520d86cb960ddf24360c7f0484a/review-evidence/21695/base-neo-theme-neo-dark.png?raw=true) | ![Neo Dark, after, with Trees hovered](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/736e061f16097520d86cb960ddf24360c7f0484a/review-evidence/21695/fixed-neo-theme-neo-dark.png?raw=true) |
| Neo Light | ![Neo Light, before, with Trees hovered](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/736e061f16097520d86cb960ddf24360c7f0484a/review-evidence/21695/base-neo-theme-neo-light.png?raw=true) | ![Neo Light, after, with Trees hovered](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/736e061f16097520d86cb960ddf24360c7f0484a/review-evidence/21695/fixed-neo-theme-neo-light.png?raw=true) |

The 1440 × 900 frames were captured on base `6952886dce` and fixed commit `e82a443619`. The reviewed head `bc918e4c61` preserves the Portal hover source shown here. [Four intervening commits](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/compare/e82a443619...bc918e4c61191c82f02f4fa236ce35e306abc3b2)

Engine hosts no `agent-preflight` script. Commit hooks passed, including CSS theme coverage and variable checks.
